verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an open-source version of RudderStack as a standalone system that depends only on PostgreSQL and includes both a data plane and a control plane. That means the core event pipeline can be run on your own infrastructure, and the compliance page reinforces this with "store data on your own infrastructure." Community threads discuss the open-source licensing (AGPLv3, later Elastic), and a Mattermost user cites "total control" of their data. missing for 10: deployment documentation (Docker/Kubernetes/installation guides), clarity on feature parity between self-hosted and cloud (e.g., Profiles, Audiences, AI features), and hands-on corroboration of running a self-hosted instance.
